visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long black hair, wearing a light yellow dress, stands in a room with a large TV and beige curtains. She raises her arms in the air while looking at the camera. (2) In a hallway with gray tiled walls, two men in navy blue uniforms are seen; one pushes a large laundry-style basket on a dolly filled with red blankets. (3) Close-up shots focus on the navy blue uniform sleeves and chest, displaying text and a dog logo. The man in the uniform gestures with his hands while talking. (4) In an indoor bedroom, two men wrap white furniture pieces, including a dresser and a dehumidifier, tightly in clear plastic stretch film. The lighting is bright and even. (5) A man wearing a black cap uses a power drill to disassemble a white wooden bed frame in a room with light-colored flooring. The woman's hand points toward the bed. (6) A man holds a gold-framed portrait of the woman, looking down at it with a smile. (7) The woman and the two men stand in a room cluttered with boxes and moving supplies, waving their hands and smiling as they finish their work at night.

(4) Sharp, percussive clacking sounds of mahjong tiles are heard in a quick sequence, interrupting the speech momentarily. narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a lifestyle vlog and an endorsement for a moving company. It starts with the creator explaining her need to move due to inconvenient location costs, introduces the moving team as 'warm' and professional, demonstrates their careful packing and furniture disassembly process, and concludes with a successful, late-night move completion.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The creator repeatedly names the company, shows their logos, and highlights their specific services and professional attitude.
